overview.zh-Hans: 该模块提供阿里云NAS（网络附加存储）文件系统的全面管理功能，包括文件系统创建、访问组管理、挂载点创建和目录配额管理。
overview.en-US: This module provides comprehensive management of Alibaba Cloud NAS (Network Attached Storage) file systems, including filesystem creation, access group management, mount target creation, and directory quota management.

description.zh-Hans: 用于创建NAS文件系统的Terraform模块，支持访问组、挂载目标和目录配额。
description.en-US: Terraform module for creating NAS file system with access groups, mount targets and directory quotas
